highlights.title: Shadow-FT: transferring fine-tuning updates
highlights.role: Co-first author (listed first in the submitted manuscript)
highlights.description: Studies weight similarity between paired base and instruction-tuned models. Fine-tuning updates learned on the base model are transferred to its instruction-tuned counterpart.

highlights.title: PTQTP: low-bit LLM inference
highlights.description: Decomposes weights into two ternary trit-planes for multiplication-free inference. Reports 4.63-fold higher end-to-end generation throughput than FP16 for LLaMA-2 7B on an RTX 3090 (batch size 1; 512 input and 512 generated tokens).

highlights.title: LoCa: logit calibration for distillation
highlights.description: Calibrates teacher logits for misclassified samples to improve knowledge distillation with limited additional computation.

experience.title: Research Intern
bullets: Built data-synthesis pipelines for image-text content moderation and used the resulting data for model post-training and evaluation.

Deployed models in tiers in production, fine-tuning large models on the full dataset and distilling smaller models using filtered data, improving throughput and reducing false positives over the previous solution.
Researched large/small model collaboration and lightweight modeling, contributing to two academic papers and one company patent.
bullets_zh: 面向图文数据审核场景，搭建数据合成管线，基于相关数据完成模型后训练与测评。
采用分级部署形式上线业务，全量数据微调大模型，数据过滤后蒸馏小模型，较前代提升吞吐率并降低误杀率。
研究大小模型协作与模型轻量化，产出两篇学术论文及一项公司专利。

current_research.title: On-policy Distillation: Thinking-Mode Transfer and Subsequent RL
current_research.summary: Thinking-mode teachers overcome saturation in standard OPD gains. Gains from non-thinking teachers decline with student size, reaching zero at 4B. With a thinking-mode teacher, 1.7B / 4B still gain 13.3 / 9.5 percentage points over their base models at a 16K budget. Behavioral evidence supports transfer of the student's own thinking mode. At 32K, 1.7B / 4B reach 90.9% / 95.2%, approaching their own thinking-mode performance, with similar results from self-distillation at all three sizes. Per-question accuracy profiles align more closely with the student's thinking mode and correlate significantly less with the external teacher, supporting gains from accessing existing reasoning capabilities. Distinguished solving a problem from delivering an answer on time. After truncation at 2K, allowing 32 additional tokens for a forced answer raises 1.7B accuracy from 17.8% to 72.8%. Used post-answer p(EOS) and continuation behavior to diagnose insufficient budgets and failure to stop, analyze transfer of teacher stopping signals, and explore a one-step correction segmented by the reference model. Characterized the benefits and compression costs of an OPD starting point for RL. Under the same downstream RL setup, 1.7B OPD+RL reaches 87.3% at 16K versus 81.7% for direct RL. Short-run RL further shows that narrower training windows produce stronger length compression but larger accuracy losses on competition problems at long budgets.

bullets_zh: 思考教师突破常规 OPD 的收益饱和。非思考教师 OPD 的增益随学生规模递减，在 4B 上降至零，改用思考模式教师后，16K 预算下，1.7B / 4B 相对基座仍提升 13.3 / 9.5 个百分点。
行为分析支持学生自身思考模式的迁移。32K 预算下，1.7B / 4B 分别达 90.9% / 95.2%，接近各自思考模式，三个尺寸的自蒸馏也取得相近表现。学生的逐题正确率轮廓与自身思考模式更一致、与外部教师的相关显著更低，支持收益可来自已有思考能力的调用。
区分“会做题”与“及时交卷”。1.7B 在 2K 截断后追加 32 tokens 强制作答，准确率从 17.8% 回升至 72.8%，结合答案后的 p(EOS) 与续写行为，分别诊断预算不足和答后不停，分析教师停止信号的迁移，并探索按参考模型分段的一步式修正。
刻画 OPD 起点对 RL 的收益与压缩代价。相同下游 RL 设置下，OPD+RL 的 1.7B 在 16K 预算上达 87.3%，高于直接 RL 的 81.7%，短程 RL 进一步揭示训练窗口的影响：窗口越窄，长度压缩越强，长预算下的竞赛题准确率损失也越大。
